fs_list.description: Lists all files and subdirectories inside a directory path, providing entry names, types (file/directory), and sizes. Accepts relative paths or ~ expansion.

fs_read.description: Reads and prints the text content of any file (up to 10,000 characters). Resolves relative paths or ~ expansion.

sys_info.description: Returns operating system details, CPU cores, RAM usage, root disk space, and uptime as JSON.

take_screenshot.description: Captures a desktop screenshot and saves it as an image file. The runtime automatically sends the captured photo to the user.
